name: Mascot DMCA
hook: Scrub your viral green-owl fan art before corporate legal busts your door
tagline: As the multiplier climbs, an indie illustrator feverishly pumps out viral goth mascot sketches while a giant neon green owl stalks the hallway outside. Cashing out submits your portfolio and logs off just before the copyright strike hits. Crashing unleashes a flock of corporate attorneys serving a devastating cease-and-desist subpoena.
